rv.q: Expanded a little from its festival roots, the show still bowls along, with lots of laughs to be found swimming in this sewer of amoralty.
The multi-roling Naylor gives a superb performance, switching between characters with flair and clarity.
For all of its fascination with the ethical lines reporters cross, in the end the text does little more than gesture vaguely at the problem.
It feels like this is more a first draft of the play than the finished version, and is in desperate need of tightening up before its next iteration
